name: Mayaku no Renkinjutsushi ~Misa~
source:
Misa is a rare witch who researches black magic in the 21st century. It deals not with curses, but with body parts transformation. She helps her friend in the same girls' school to get a huge rack. From now on she helps any girl in need to eliminate her body defects. As a result school gets drowned in lust.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
美纱是一位在21世纪罕见地钻研黑魔法的魔女。她所研究的黑魔法并非诅咒，而是改造身体部位的秘术。她先是帮同在女校就读的好友变出了一对傲人巨乳，此后更是有求必应，帮助任何有烦恼的女生消除身材缺陷——结果整所女校就此彻底淹没在情欲的狂潮之中。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
